question: What is/are the trading symbol(s) and listing exchange(s)?
rationale: Two complementary rules cover the two distinct cover-page layouts found across the 10 sampled docs. rule_cover_page_security_listing scans page 1 for class/exchange/trading-symbol keywords (Common Stock, Ordinary Shares, NYSE, Nasdaq, 'Trading symbol', 'Name of each exchange', 'Title of each class') and additionally grabs up to 5 spans following a bare 'Symbol' / 'Trading Symbol(s)' label so the value span (e.g. AAPL, GLW, BBY) is captured even when separated by other cover spans. rule_traded_under_symbol picks up the Item-5 sentence 'traded/listed on ... under the (ticker) symbol X' but is conditionally gated to fire only when the cover page lacks a 'Trading symbol' string — i.e. older 10-K filings (Amazon 2015, Apple 2017/2018, BestBuy 2015) whose covers omit the ticker; this gating was necessary because the 'GIS only' Item-5 sentence in newer filings was biasing the QA model toward a single-row answer for GENERALMILLS instead of enumerating all 5 securities. Final sum_avg_cost_ratio=0.00156 with match_rate=1.0 hits both the cost and rule-count soft targets comfortably.
